note: These contracts describe the OBIE v3.1.x-compliant endpoints exposed by SVC-017 (Digital Channels channel service) to TPPs, and the internal synchronous REST contracts between SVC-017 and SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). SVC-017 is a CHANNEL service — it is not a capability. Internal contracts are channel → capability (synchronous REST is permitted by architectural principle).

security.application: OAuth 2.0 with JAR (JWT Authorisation Request) signed with OBIE-issued signing certificate

endpoints.summary: Create a Domestic Payment Consent resource. Called by the TPP before the customer authorisation redirect. Creates ENT-030 with status = awaiting_auth.

headers.x-fapi-auth-date: string (RFC 7231 date) — last customer login time (optional per OBIE but recommended)
headers.x-fapi-interaction-id: string (UUID) — idempotency key for this request

InstructedAmount.Currency: string — ISO 4217, GBP only for domestic

CreditorAccount.Identification: string — sort code + account number, e.g. '20000012345678' (14 digits, no separators)
CreditorAccount.Name: string — payee name, max 70 chars

error_responses.400: Bad Request — schema validation failure or invalid sort code/account number
error_responses.403: Forbidden — TPP not authorised for payments scope or TPPRegistration.status != active
error_responses.422: Unprocessable Entity — business rule failure (e.g. amount exceeds FPS limit)

endpoints.summary: Read a Domestic Payment Consent. Returns current consent status. Used by TPP to check consent state.

Data.Status: string — enum: AwaitingAuthorisation | Authorised | Consumed | Revoked
Data.Initiation: object — original payment details as submitted

error_responses.403: Forbidden — consent does not belong to this TPP's client_id
error_responses.404: Not Found — ConsentId does not exist

endpoints.summary: Initiate a Domestic Payment using an authorised consent. Called by the TPP after receiving the access token. SVC-017 validates the token and consent, then calls SVC-001 synchronously to create ENT-008 PaymentIntent and consume ENT-030.

headers.Authorization: Bearer <access_token — bound to ConsentId via scope>
headers.x-fapi-interaction-id: string (UUID) — idempotency key; duplicate request with same ConsentId returns 200 OK with existing payment resource

Data.ConsentId: string (UUID) — must match the authorised consent

endpoints.idempotency: Duplicate POST with same ConsentId where ENT-030.status = consumed returns 200 OK with the existing DomesticPaymentId. Does not create a second PaymentIntent.

error_responses.400: Bad Request — schema validation or Initiation mismatch with consent
error_responses.403: Forbidden — token not bound to ConsentId, or consent not authorised, or consent consumed/revoked/expired
error_responses.422: Unprocessable Entity — OBIE error codes: UK.OBIE.Rules.AccountNotFound (insufficient funds or inactive account), UK.OBIE.Rules.DailyLimitExceeded

endpoints.summary: Read the status of a Domestic Payment. Used by the TPP to poll payment status. SVC-017 reads from the payment status cache (updated by EVT-062 / EVT-063). Rate limited to 10 requests per minute per DomesticPaymentId.

error_responses.403: Forbidden — payment does not belong to this TPP
error_responses.429: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded (10/min). Retry-After header included.

internal_apis.note: Internal synchronous REST contracts between SVC-017 (channel) and SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). Channel → capability calls are permitted by architectural principle.

endpoints.summary: SVC-017 creates an ENT-030 OpenBankingConsent record in SVC-001. Called synchronously during TPP POST /domestic-payment-consents handling.
SVC-017 updates ENT-030 after customer SCA and consent confirmation. Sets status = authorised, links customer_id and account_id, records SCA method and CoP result.

request_body.cop_result: string (optional) — enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist

endpoints.summary: SVC-017 initiates payment. SVC-001 validates consent state, account balance, and daily limit. Atomically creates ENT-008 and consumes ENT-030. Publishes EVT-179 and EVT-061.

error_responses.422_consent_mismatch: Payment details do not match stored consent (amount, payee)

endpoints.summary: SVC-017 reads PaymentIntent status for TPP polling. Returns current status and completed_at/fps_reference when available.

response_200.status: string — enum: pending_screening | processing | completed | failed | fraud_blocked | sanctions_blocked | cancelled
response_200.failure_reason: string — internal only, must not be forwarded to TPP verbatim
